Our [published robots.txt](https://docs.broadcastwell.com/robots.txt) supplies a concrete scope check: in the 3 November 2026 snapshot, both `Googlebot` and `Google-Extended` have separate groups with `Allow: /`. The same path text belongs to two distinct declarations, so reporting only that Google-Extended is allowed would omit the Search crawler's own rule. The file records what we declared, not a visit, indexing event or change in AI Overview visibility.
